mentions.name: seabed-sim-chrono
mentions.description: A deep seabed simulation built in Project Chrono to simulate polymetallic nodules for cobalt/nickel mining. It includes a fast but inaccurate rigid-body simulation and a DEM (discrete element method) simulation that benefits from lots of fast cache. The idea is that users can load a vehicle in Project Chrono and test deep sea nodule mining using different designs.

mentions.name: seabed-sim-chrono
mentions.description: A physics simulation of deep sea polymetallic nodule mining, built with Project Chrono using its granular terrain modeling. Still in an early stage of development — the author's old polymetallic nodule samples have not yet been added and nothing is to scale — but it already runs.
mentions.source_excerpt: just for fun I've been building a simulation for it. It's been done a million times before but I wanted to do it myself in project chrono using their granular terrain and old polymetallic nodule samples I have
